routeGate.claim: Three-click arcade golf on a deterministic ball-flight sim (launch/spin/wind → terrain bounce/roll → cup). Six authored courses × 9 holes from Scottish dunes to a 1/6-gravity lunar mare: certified terrain sampler drives both physics and visuals. Shot-shaping via accuracy/spin clicks, lie/wind penalties, stroke play with skins tiebreak, Range Lab + Putting Lab, 32-player Pro Circuit, Player Studio. Publishes window.__AURA3D_SHOWCASE_AURA_LINKS_3D__ and __AURA3D_GAME_EVIDENCE__.
